svg.title: KrishiRakshak technology stack
svg.text: From training a model to a farmer's phone to an officer's map
offline · trained once, shipped as INT8
INT8 MODELS BUNDLED IN APK (6.82 MB)
Marathi and Hindi, no voice files
Buffer in Node, struct in Python
EXTERNAL SERVICES, STATUTORY ENGINES & HARDWARE INTEGRATIONS
Edge Autonomy Rule: The mobile phone executes deterministic EXIF canonicalization, dual INT8 inferences (YOLOv8n + EfficientNet-Lite0), and CIB&RC pump dosages 100% offline.
The cloud tier, PostGIS clustering, and officer dashboard sync automatically when connectivity is restored.
